name: Her Lullaby
source:
Her Lullaby is a story of two people who are total strangers to one another waking up in the same place and wanting nothing more than to kill one another. If the noise and headaches would stop for only a few moments... maybe some kind of understanding can be reached.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=42546]LemmaSoft thread[/url]]
translation:
《她的摇篮曲》讲述两名完全陌生的人在同一个地方醒来，除了杀死对方之外别无他求。如果噪音与头痛能暂时停歇片刻……也许他们能够彼此理解。

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=42546]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
